content.text: JwtStrategy uses refreshSecret; should be auth.secret. Quickly verify signing.

candidates.explanation: JwtStrategy verifies access tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret', but AuthService.getTokensData signs access tokens with 'auth.secret' (the refresh secret is only for refresh tokens). Signature verification fails for every access token, so passport returns 401 on all protected endpoints. Login and refresh still work because the refresh strategy correctly uses the refresh secret.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret: configService.getOrThrow('auth.secret', { infer: true }).
